# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest tagged release and the current main branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for security problems, especially anything that can
break NVDA speech at startup or execute unexpected code.

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting: open the repository, go to the
Security tab, then choose Report a vulnerability. You can also contact the
maintainer directly through GitHub.

You will get an initial response as soon as possible, and a fix will be
released before any public disclosure.
